Chapter 921: Chapter 19 Origin World (Please Subscribe)_2

“Time flow ratio…”

Lin Yuan paused for just a moment, ascertaining the time flow ratio between this Origin World and the Main Universe, and then the thread of spiritual will that had descended began to disintegrate and shatter.

“Three hundred to one…”

Lin Yuan’s expression was solemn.

Simply put, three hundred years in the Main Universe would pass, while only one year would elapse in that Origin World.

Based on Lin Yuan’s multiple descents into other dimensional worlds, the higher the level of the world, the slower the time flow ratio.

The time flow ratio of three hundred to one between the Main Universe and that Origin World signifies that the latter’s world hierarchy is higher than the Main Universe.

This was also the first time Lin Yuan discovered a world with a hierarchy even higher than the Main Universe; even the Immortal Realm was merely on par with the Main Universe, and in reality, still inferior to it.

“Let’s see the next Origin World…” Lin Yuan looked towards the second Origin World coordinate.

Among the thirty-three Origin World coordinates, Lin Yuan could only clearly make out the first three.

“Hmm?”

Just as Lin Yuan was about to use the Myriad Realms Gate to descend with a thread of spiritual will into the world corresponding to this Origin World coordinate, he received an instinctual warning from the Myriad Realms Gate.

This Origin World is unique; approaching recklessly will cause a certain degree of discomfort.

“Then forget it.” Lin Yuan immediately gave up.

His exploration of the second Origin World was purely out of curiosity, with no thoughts of descending and traversing in the near future.

After all, there was still the first Origin World coordinate ahead.

If Lin Yuan were indeed to traverse and descend, he would definitely prioritize the first Origin World.

…

Xuantian Immortal Domain.

Cangwu Immortal City.

Jade Immortals from thirty-three Immortal Domains quickly gathered.

“I heard that this Celestial-Demonic War ended early because of Master Yun Zhenzi?”

An elderly top-tier Jade Immortal stopped outside the Immortal City, looked towards the other arriving Jade Immortals, and whispered:

“This Master Yun Zhenzi intervened, resolved six Emperor of Demonic Beings and countless demons, and the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss not only did not pursue the matter but also ordered all demons to retreat to the Demon Abyss?”

The surrounding multitude of Jade Immortals, although having heard such claims before and unsure of their truth, were still astounded.

What kind of existence is the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss? He is an Ancestral Master-level powerhouse who has confronted the Ancestor of the Immortal Path for countless years, and throughout past Celestial-Demonic Wars, countless immortals have fallen at the hands of demons.

Such a supremely fierce and unparalleled powerhouse, yet so amicable in front of Master Yun Zhenzi?

“I am on good terms with the lord of Cangwu Immortal City.” At this moment, another shorter Jade Immortal spoke up: “Master Yun Zhenzi is not only an Alchemy Master but also established himself as the Ancestor of Martial Arts, spreading the Martial Tao Cultivation System.”

“Ancestor of Martial Arts? Martial Tao Cultivation System?”

The gathered Jade Immortals looked at each other; they had never heard of such a cultivation system before, but since it produced a powerhouse like Master Yun Zhenzi, it was evidently not to be underestimated.

“Ancestor of Martial Arts? Could it be that he plans to stand equal to the Ancestor of the Immortal Path and the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss?” A Jade Immortal could not help but say.

“The strength of the Ancestor of Martial Arts, even if not as great as the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss or the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, is probably not far behind.” The other Jade Immortals silently thought.

Since he dares to call himself the Ancestor of Martial Arts, he must have already considered the Ancestor of the Immortal Path and the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

To be able to cultivate to the Jade Immortal Stage, none are fools, especially not Master Yun Zhenzi.

If he didn’t have the confidence and strength, to claim to be the Ancestor of Martial Arts would be suicidal.

“I wonder if we’ll get to meet the Ancestor of Martial Arts this time.” The many Jade Immortals discussed amongst themselves.

They traveled across various Immortal Domains to Cangwu Immortal City, with the purpose of meeting the Ancestor of Martial Arts.

The ultimate truths converge from different paths; be it Martial Tao or Immortal Path, at the level of the Ancestor of Martial Arts and the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, a high vantage point dictates all, and a casual remark could enlighten them immensely.

Even if the Ancestor of Martial Arts did not provide guidance, just to see such an existence was extremely worthwhile.

After all, most Jade Immortals wouldn’t see the Ancestor of the Immortal Path even once in millions or tens of millions of years.

…

While the many Jade Immortals patiently waited outside the city.

The lord of Cangwu Immortal City flew out, looked towards the gathering of Jade Immortals, and announced: “Fellow Daoists, the Martial Ancestor is willing to see you.”

Upon hearing this.

All the visiting Jade Immortals were deeply shaken.

Their haste to arrive was for the sole purpose of meeting the Martial Ancestor, wasn’t it?

Yet without the Martial Ancestor’s permission, they dared not enter Cangwu Immortal City on their own and could only wait outside the city.

Soon.

Under the leadership of the Lord of Cangwu Immortal City.

The first batch of Jade Immortals entered the Immortal City one after another, and came to the Cave Mansion Area, where they saw a young man sitting cross-legged.

“Greetings to the Martial Ancestor.”

“Greetings to the Martial Ancestor.”

“Greetings to the Martial Ancestor.”

Even just by looking from afar, all the Jade Immortals trembled in their hearts, as they could not sense the specific aura of the Martial Ancestor.

Before seeing the Martial Ancestor, many images had already surfaced in their minds, such as how formidable and terrifying the aura of the Martial Ancestor was, enough to collapse space and time, and so on.

But when they actually met the Martial Ancestor, they found themselves utterly unable to perceive his might.

“Hmm…”

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, smiling as he looked at the many Jade Immortals, “Next, I will explain to you what Martial Tao is…”

Lin Yuan’s willingness to meet these Jade Immortals was not out of sheer kindness, but rather, to prepare for the spread of Martial Tao.

The propagation of Martial Tao is crucial at the grassroots level, but it is equally important to spread it among the higher levels.

The Jade Immortals gathered here were essentially the top-notch powerhouses of the Immortal Realm. Although they all practiced the Immortal Path cultivation system, they all had numerous disciples and descendants, and were leaders of their respective forces.

If these Jade Immortals recognized the potential and power of Martial Tao, even if they did not switch to cultivating Martial Tao themselves, their descendants and disciples would surely consider it as an alternative when choosing their cultivation system.

Thus, Lin Yuan’s goal would be achieved.

Of course, doing so was not without risks, as it might provoke the resentment of the top-tier powerhouses, but Lin Yuan had already reached an agreement with the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss, so spreading Martial Tao was nothing out of the ordinary.

“Explaining Martial Tao?”

“The Martial Ancestor is imparting his teachings…”

The thoughts of the many Jade Immortals drifted. Before the Martial Ancestor, there was only one being in the Immortal Realm who had imparted the path, and that was the Ancestor of the Immortal Path.

What is imparting the path? It is to express one’s own path and make it known to all beings in heaven and earth.

The numerous Jade Immortals’ thoughts fluctuated, but soon they no longer had the energy to ponder these matters, as they quickly became engrossed in Lin Yuan’s explanation of the essence of Martial Tao.

…

At the innermost depths of the Immortal Realm.

The rules of the Great Dao easily manifest here.

Several figures have gathered here; they are all direct disciples of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, authorized to reside permanently in the Primordial Lands.

Origin of the Immortal Realm, the safest place in the Immortal Realm, unaffected by any turmoil outside, even the rampages of the Emperor of Demonic Beings cannot reach here.

“What audacity, to dare claim himself as the Ancestor of Martial Arts?”

“Indeed, our master is the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, does he intend to place himself on the same level as our master by claiming to be the Ancestor of Martial Arts?”

“It’s rumored that this Yun Zhenzi solved six Emperors of Demonic Beings with a mere gesture, but after all, it’s only a rumor. Even if it’s true, does he really think he can compare with our master?”

The direct disciples of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path quickly exchanged words, their tone brimming with resentment.

The emergence of the Ancestor of Martial Arts has had a profound impact on the thirty-three domains of the Immortal Realm; some Jade Immortals feel that the Ancestor of Martial Arts is not much weaker than the Ancestor of the Immortal Path and have gone to meet him.

Some are still observing.

The rest, led by the lineage of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, regard the Ancestor of Martial Arts as nothing but a mere jester.

Although it’s said that the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss backed down because of the Ancestor of Martial Arts and even withdrew countless demonic beings invading the Immortal Realm, this has never been confirmed.

The direct disciples of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path here simply don’t believe it.

“Too presumptuous.”

“I will summon that Yun Zhenzi now, and have him come here to apologize.”

The senior direct disciple of the Ancestral Master of the Immortal Path rose, about to proclaim this to the thirty-three domains of the Immortal Realm in the name of their master’s lineage.

Just then.

A voice rang out.

“From today onward, no one is allowed to take any actions against the Ancestor of Martial Arts.”

There appeared a figure in a Taoist robe, an emaciated old man with far-reaching eyes and an aura that influenced the surrounding rules – the Ancestor of the Immortal Path himself.
